verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a payments and developer platform like CDP, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency for user or account data. The sandbox, webhooks, CLI/MCP and payment-rail docs are about other capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
